newsitem.title: USA: FIGURE SKATING-SCOTT HAMILTON HAS CANCER.
newsitem.headline: FIGURE SKATING-SCOTT HAMILTON HAS CANCER.

text.p: Olympic gold medal-winning figure skater Scott Hamilton has been diagnosed with testicular cancer and will undergo chemotherapy, his doctors announced Wednesday.

The 38-year-old skater, who won the gold medal in Sarajevo in 1984 and was a four-time world champion, underwent a series of tests at a hospital in Cleveland, Ohio, this week after complaining of recent stomach pains.
Doctors confirmed a tumour in Hamilton's lower abdomen was caused by cancer cells in his testicle area.
The doctors agreed that chemotherapy was the best form of treatment. They noted that men with a similar condition had a 70-80 percent cure rate.
"I feel 100 percent confident that I can overcome this disease and be back on the ice within a few months," Hamilton said in a statement.
Hamilton, who had been headlining a 60-city U.S. tour of the ice show "Discover Stars on Ice," last performed in Peoria, Illinois, Sunday.
He will not appear in the remaining seven scheduled cities and has cancelled appearances in Europe and Asia.
